chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

answers.q1_what_did_you_play: I played Shinobu — Sanctifying Ring, killing both Leaf Slimes, gaining 4 Block, and damaging the Twig Slime's Block. Then I played All Streams Flow to the Sea on Twig Slime (S).
answers.q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered Water's Edge on one Leaf Slime and All Streams Flow to the Sea on the other, killing both without using Shinobu — Sanctifying Ring.
answers.q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up keeping Shinobu — Sanctifying Ring and Water's Edge, and left 1 Energy unused; in exchange, it used the stronger follow-up on the remaining enemy and gained enough Block for the telegraphed attack.
answers.q4_different_intent: No. Given only this hand and board, the same line efficiently removes both 3-HP enemies, uses the strongest remaining hit on Twig Slime (S), and adds Block, so a different telegraphed intent would not have changed it.
